page.layout: One page of running text in one column, right of centre, with a printed page number and running head at the top. Headings are centred, italic, in the text column. No margin notes, no footnotes, no catchword, no signature. The text ends at the bottom of the column.

main_text.l: Est virtus, quæ in hominum societate tuenda, tri-
buendoq; suum cuique, & rerum contractarum fide
versatur. Justitiæ fundamentum est fides dictorum,
conventorumq; constantia, & veritas: Dicta, quia fiat
Injustitiæ duo sunt genera : Unum eorum, qui in-
ferunt injuriam: Alterum eorum qui ab iis, quibus in-
Ad justitiam. Habet autem liberalitas tres cautio-
nes: Quomodo dandum sit, quantum & quibus.
Ita, ne obsit benignitas & iis, quibus benignè vi-
Cuiquè pro dignitate, in qua consideranda sunt
quatuor: Mores ejus in quem beneficium confertur:
Animus & benevolentia erga nos: Officia nobis ante
primus est universi generis humani : Secun-
dus ejusdem gentis: Tertius ejusdem civitatis : Quar-
Est virtus, quæ in animi excelsi & invicti magnitudine

page.notes: Printed heading words are underlined in the scan; the underlining is not transcribed. The last line is cut off by the page edge at the right and continues on a following page; "dine" at the right is a catchword-like fragment of the word "magnitudine" and is kept as a line end. Some words at the right edge are partly hidden by the scan edge and were read from context where the printed letters were clear. The word "tribuendoq;" is read as printed. Word "collata" and "Communitas" are clear. No marginal notes are printed.
